title: Canonical Order
description: The canonical enterprise order contract. This defines what an order MEANS in the business, independent of any external system. SQL is the source of truth; Computyme, Shopify, EDI, and future ERPs are adapters that map to/from this contract. Consumers may ignore or partially implement fields; the contract still owns the truth.

schemaVersion.description: Contract version this payload conforms to. Consumers branch on this. Bump minor for additive changes, major for breaking changes.

metadata.description: Identity and provenance of the payload.

orderId.description: Canonical, immutable order identifier owned by the SQL platform. NOT a channel order number (those live in references).

orderNumber.description: Human-facing order number, if different from orderId.

createdAt.description: When the order was created in the canonical platform.

updatedAt.description: Last modification time in the canonical platform.

channelOrderId.description: The order id as known by the originating channel (e.g. Shopify order id, EDI control number).

storeId.description: Sub-channel identifier (POS register, Shopify store, EDI trading partner).

pricingTier.description: Customer pricing segment (e.g. RETAIL, WHOLESALE, CONTRACT_A). Drives pricing rules.

poNumber.description: Customer's purchase order number for this order.

addresses.description: Order-level billing and default shipping. Per-group ship-to overrides live in fulfillment.

shipping.description: Default ship-to. Optional when every fulfillment group carries its own shipTo.

currency.description: Currency for all monetary amounts on the order. Per-Money currency must match this.

taxInclusive.description: Whether line/total amounts already include tax.

paymentTerms.description: Commercial payment terms agreed for the order.

code.description: Business terms code, such as NET30.

netDays.description: Number of days from the applicable order or invoice date.

dueDate.description: Explicit payment due date when known.

pricing.description: Order-level monetary rollups. Line detail lives in items; this is the summary the business agrees on.

subtotal.description: Sum of line totals before order-level discounts, shipping, and tax.

shippingTotal.description: Total freight/shipping charged to the customer.

grandTotal.description: Final amount due. The number both sides reconcile against.

orderDiscounts.description: Discounts applied at the order level (not tied to a single line).

items.description: Order lines. At least one. See order-item.schema.json.

payments.description: Payment records against the order. May be empty for terms/on-account orders.

reference.description: Processor/transaction reference, masked card token, etc. Never raw PAN.

workflow.description: Explicit workflow state: approvals, holds, and export tracking. Makes implicit process state first-class.

holds.description: Active holds blocking the order. Empty means clear to proceed.

references.description: Cross-system identifiers at the order level, keyed by system name. Lets every adapter find its own id without owning a canonical field.

extensions.description: Namespaced escape hatch for channel-specific or not-yet-canonical data. Each consumer reads only its own namespace. Adding data here NEVER requires a schema change and never contaminates canonical fields. Promote a field to canonical only when it has cross-system business meaning.

riskScore.description: Fraud/credit risk score if scored. Null if not evaluated.

events.description: Append-only audit trail of significant state changes.
